comment.body: Thanks for the concrete report about Mouse Without Borders: Modifier key gets stuck on other PCs when toggling off "All PC mode", including the version, affected PowerToys area, and observed behavior. The remaining ambiguity is the exact failing path or whether this still reproduces on a current build, so a generic checklist would not help. Please provide numbered steps naming the exact All PC mode shortcut, modifier key, two-PC topology, and whether the key is held during the toggle; state whether reconnecting clears the remote stuck key and include /bugreport after reproducing if possible. This will distinguish the competing triage paths and determine whether the proposed fix should target the reported behavior or a different configuration or lifecycle condition.
